answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize an atlas of decentralized identity attestations to bind agents to unique human counterparts. By imposing a delta in computational or financial cost for each new identity creation, the system ensures that the economic barrier to entry acts like a digital pearl, hardening the network against Sybil floods. An attacker must incur linear costs for every sub-identity, rendering large-scale identity replication unprofitable in a resource-constrained environment.
